entities.name: Table T1 – Data Center Financing: Five financing paths for global data center spend
entities.brief: Distribution of $2.9tr global data center capex across five funding sources
entities.description: Breakdown of $2.9 trillion global data center capex (2025-2028) by financing source, highlighting a $1.5tr external funding gap led by private credit

properties.table_content:
| Capital Source Category | Amount | Description/Details |
|-------------------------|--------|---------------------|
| Hyperscaler Cash Flows  | $1.4tr | Covered by Hyperscaler Cash Flows |
| Corporate Debt Issuance | $200bn | Corporate Debt Issuance |
| Securitized Credit      | $150bn | Securitized Credit Issuance (ABS, CMBS) |
| Private Credit          | $800bn | Opportunity for Private Credit via Asset-based Finance & Debt Funding of JVs |
| Other Capital           | $350bn | Primarily PE, VC, Sovereign |
properties.key_insight: External financing sources collectively fill a $1.5 trillion gap, with private credit leading at $800bn.
